title: Thunder 3 SV White

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The MT Helmets Thunder 3 SV White is engineered for responsive sport riding with pinpoint lateral stability, pairing agile street ergonomics with certified multi-impact protection. Built around a Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell weighing 1464g, its multi-density EPS matrix is aerodynamically sculpted to isolate cabin noise to ~86 dB while dissipating kinetic impact forces across ECE 22.05 benchmarks. Inside, 3D laser-cut cheek pads tailor naturally to an Intermediate Oval profile with dedicated eyewear relief channels, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for confident all-day riding.

product_details.description: MT Thunder 3 full face with sun visor.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for oval to intermediate head shapes; features a multi-position dial and adjustable cheek pads for a secure fit.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the MT Helmets Thunder 3 SV White: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: MT Helmets Thunder 3 SV White: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the MT Helmets Thunder 3 SV White. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

qualitative_intelligence.visor_optical_clarity: Class 1 Distortion-Free Optically Correct shield with Pinlock 120 MaxVision anti-fog lens insert included.

Lightweight shell construction reduces neck strain on long rides
Plush, fully removable and washable antimicrobial cheek liners

introduction: Positioned in MT Helmets's Full Face lineup, the Thunder 3 SV White brings Global Premium engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The MT Helmets Thunder 3 SV White represents MT Helmets's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~86 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking an Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) Full Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the MT Helmets Thunder 3 SV White delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
